snippet.title: Depth-Bound - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
🌊 ADD TO WISHLIST ➜ https://store.steampowered.com/app/4557090/DepthBound/
🐳 MORE INFOS ➜ https://linktr.ee/depthbound

▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬
[ 𝗗𝗘𝗣𝗧𝗛 𝗕𝗢𝗨𝗡𝗗 — 𝗔 𝗣𝗵𝘆𝘀𝗶𝗰𝘀-𝗕𝗮𝘀𝗲𝗱 𝗨𝗻𝗱𝗲𝗿𝘄𝗮𝘁𝗲𝗿 𝗣𝗹𝗮𝘁𝗳𝗼𝗿𝗺𝗲𝗿 ]

🚀 Propel yourself out of the water, chain trajectories, and dive always deeper into the abyss.
📸 Photograph strange creatures lurking in the dark.
🗺️ Follow an expedition whose outcome remains uncertain.
▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬▬

A game by Minusc
Title artwork by Mortis Ghost
